# Backend Change Proposal — Liquid Glass Mobile Design

Source: 5 area proposals (taxonomy, feed, detail, personal, delivery), each adversarially reviewed. This document keeps only what survived review, corrects factual errors the reviewers caught, and folds in what they found missing.

## 1. The short version

- **Two new tables carry almost the whole design**: `saved_ads` (favorite heart, consistent across every screen that shows a listing) and `notifications` (bell + notifications screen, §22). Everything else is either already there or a couple of nullable columns.
- **`Ad.lat`/`Ad.lng` (nullable Decimal) is the one real gap in listing-detail** — SCREENS.md is explicit the map pin must use "the ad's real coordinates, not dummy data," and `apps/web/src/components/pin/Pin.jsx` already dereferences `item.latitude/longitude` on data that has never existed in Postgres.
- **Most filter/sort fields the search UI needs already exist**: rooms, area, price, furniture, repair, storey, city, district are all filterable today via `adService.buildAdFilters` (`apps/api/src/services/adService.js`). Only free-text search (`q`), `sort`, and pagination are missing from the public `GET /api/ads`.
- **Drop the Apartment/House/Office/Retail taxonomy migration.** It appears in exactly one place (the home-feed chip row), is wired only as decorative CSS-class toggling identical to the tab bar, and the canonical filter screen (SCREENS.md §5) doesn't reference it at all. Don't add a schema column for a chip row that isn't wired to filtering yet.
- **Drop the composed `GET /api/feed/home` endpoint.** Nothing forces one round trip; every other multi-widget need in this API is already served one-endpoint-per-resource, and a composed endpoint forces one cache TTL across rails of very different volatility.
- **Drop `AdPhoto.width/height/blurhash`.** The design's own CSS fixes every image slot's box size with `object-fit:cover` — there's no loading-placeholder UX anywhere in the spec for this to solve.
- **`regions.json` needs a new home, not a new endpoint.** It's static, hand-authored, build-time reference data — move it into a shared package both `apps/web` and `apps/mobile` import, don't stand up an API route to serve a file that never changes.
- Five open product questions gate real schema decisions (Featured curation, Top Agents/coworkers, notification recipients, Explore Nearby semantics, callback reminders) — see §5.

## 2. What the current backend already supports

No change needed for any of this — it's already real, already returned, already filterable:

| Design element | Backing today |
|---|---|
| Rooms / area / price / furniture / repair / storey filters | `adService.buildAdFilters` — `?rooms=`, `?areaMin=`/`?areaMax=`, `?priceMin=`/`?priceMax=`, `?furniture=`, `?repairment=`, `?storey=` |
| City / district filtering | `?city=`/`?district=`, exact match on `Ad.city`/`Ad.district` |
| Category (Rent/Sale), Type (Residential/Nonresidential) | `AdCategory`, `AdType` enums, `?category=`/`?type=` |
| `GET /api/ads?agentId=` | Already works — `buildAdFilters` unconditionally sets `where.agentId` for any caller, and the public route passes `req.query` straight through with no options object. (One proposal claimed this needed a code change; it doesn't.) |
| Listing-detail hero/fact-rail/Sizes/Description tabs | All direct `Ad` scalar fields, already in `serializeAd` (`apps/api/src/lib/adsSerializer.js`) |
| Description tags (Residential/Sale/Excellent repair/With furniture) | `Ad.type`, `Ad.category`, `Ad.repairment`, `Ad.furniture` — already reverse-mapped via domain enums |
| Photo ordering | `AdPhoto.position`, already sorted into a flat `photos: string[]` by `serializeAd` |
| Nearby tab chip labels | `Ad.nearPlaces: String[]` plus the canonical `GET /api/utils/nearby-places` vocabulary |
| `options` key/value rows (SCREENS.md §7 line 142) | Already returned as `optionList: ad.options` on `GET /ads/:id` |
| Agent phone (Call button) | `User.phoneNumber`, already on `GET /agents/:id` |
| Top Agents' `{n} ads` count | `GET /api/agents` already computes `adsCount` via `activityEvent.groupBy({by:['agentId'], where:{type:'AD_CREATED'}})` |
| Location switcher pill | `Ad.city` + existing `?city=` filter; the pill itself is decorative/unwired per the design |
| CRM Description tags, price-per-m² inputs | Existing scalar fields; price-per-m² is a one-line division at read time, not a stored column |

## 3. Schema changes

Ordered by how much of the design each unblocks.

| Model | Change | Forced by | Breaking | Migration note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SavedAd** (new, `saved_ads`) | `id Uuid @id @default(uuid())`; `userId String @db.Uuid` FK→User (Cascade); `adId String @db.Uuid` FK→Ad (Cascade); `createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz()`. `@@unique([userId, adId])`, `@@index([userId])`, `@@index([adId])`. No explicit `@relation` name needed — each is the only relation between its model pair. | Heart pre-toggled "on" identically on Featured Listings, Explore Nearby, and listing-detail for ad-1001 — proves it's a real per-(user,listing) persisted boolean, not client state. Also backs the saved-listings screen (§17). | No | New, empty table. No backfill — no favorites concept exists anywhere today (web's `profilePage.jsx` saved-list section has no data source either). |
| **Ad** | Add `lat Decimal? @db.Decimal(9,6)`, `lng Decimal? @db.Decimal(9,6)` | Location tab map pin — SCREENS.md explicitly calls out fixing "the ad's real coordinates, not dummy data." `apps/web/src/components/pin/Pin.jsx` already reads `item.latitude/longitude`; `apps/web/src/components/map/Map.jsx` hardcodes its center to Coventry, UK because there's nothing real to center on. | No | Nullable, defaults null. Existing ads render no pin (client falls back to city-level center) until geocoded — see Decision 3. |
| **Notification** (new) + **NotificationType** (new enum) | `id Uuid @id`; `recipientId Uuid` FK→User (Cascade); `type NotificationType`; `title String`; `body String` (rendered snapshot, not just a ref); `adId Uuid?` FK→Ad (SetNull); `leadId Uuid?` FK→Lead (SetNull); `coworkerId Uuid?` FK→User (SetNull); `readAt DateTime? @db.Timestamptz()`; `createdAt`. `@@index([recipientId, createdAt])`, `@@index([recipientId, readAt])`. Enum: `LEAD_CREATED, AD_SOLD, COWORKER_AD_CREATED, IG_PUBLISHED, CALLBACK_REMINDER`. | Notifications screen (§4.4, §22) — 5 seeded rows, each type-routed (new lead → lead-detail, IG published → publish-status, sold → edit-listing, coworker activity → coworker-detail, callback → lead-detail). `ActivityEvent` can't provide this: no `readAt`, no per-recipient concept — an agent and their coworkers share one `agentId`-keyed event stream but need independent read state. | No | New, empty tables/enum. Bell shows 0 unread for every existing user until new qualifying events occur post-deploy — expected, not a regression. Add a `packages/domain/src/enums/notifications.ts` mirror at the same time (see §7 — `EventType` already drifted this way once). |
| **Ad** | Add `tour3dLink String? @map("tour_3d_link")` | SCREENS.md §7: "embedded 3D tour iframe if `tour3dLink` present" — no field exists for this today. | No | Nullable; existing ads have no tour link. |
| **AdPhoto** | Add `mediaType AdMediaType @default(PHOTO)`, new enum `AdMediaType { PHOTO VIDEO }` | SCREENS.md §7: "Photo/video carousel". `AdPhoto` can't distinguish a photo from the video the CRM form already accepts (up to 70MB; `POST /api/uploads/presign` already allows `video/*`). | No | Defaulted; existing rows become `PHOTO`. |
| **User** *(GET /agents/:id extension — no new column, just a query)* | `adsCount` (same `AD_CREATED` groupBy as `GET /agents`) and `dealsClosedCount` (count of `Ad` rows with `stage=SOLD` for that agent) added to the single-agent response | Listing-detail agent block: "Agent · 24 listings · 9 closed" (§4.3, Javlon Rustamov row matches exactly). | No | Pure read-path change, no migration. |
| **Ad** | `@@index([stage, active, createdAt])` (extends existing `[stage, active]`) | Supports keyset (`createdAt`+`id`) pagination on `GET /api/ads` for the listing-search screen (§4). | No | Additive index. If the ads table has grown past seed scale by rollout, apply via `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` outside Prisma's default transactional migration. |
| **Ad** | `@@index([city, district])` | `GET /api/ads/top-districts` groupBy — without this it's a full scan as inventory grows. | No | Pure index addition. |
| **Ad** *(conditional — pending Decision 1)* | `featured Boolean @default(false)`, `featuredAt DateTime? @db.Timestamptz()`, `@@index([featured, stage])` | Only if Featured Listings is decided to be manually curated rather than algorithmic. | No | All existing ads default `false`; someone needs write access to flag the first batch (no ADMIN role exists today). |
| **Lead** *(conditional — pending Decision 7)* | `callbackReminderSentAt DateTime? @db.Timestamptz()` | Only if CALLBACK_REMINDER moves from "computed live" to a real scheduled sweep needing dedupe. | No | Do not build until the decision is made — see §5. |

**Explicitly not adding:** `AdSubtype` enum / `Ad.propertyType` (see §7), `AdPhoto.width/height/blurhash` (see §7), `PromoBanner` (see §5 Decision, recommend against for v1).

## 4. API changes

| Method & path | New/extended | Purpose | Response shape |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/ads` | Extended | Add `q` (free-text OR-contains, case-insensitive, across `title`/`city`/`district`), `sort=newest\|highestPrice\|lowestPrice` (today hardcoded to `createdAt desc`), `limit`/`cursor` keyed on `(createdAt, id)` for infinite-scroll on the listing-search screen (§4). | `Ad[]` unchanged when no `limit` passed; slice of that size when `limit` is passed, client infers more pages when `result.length === limit`. No envelope change. |
| `GET /api/ads` | Extended *(conditional on Decision 1)* | `featured=true` filter, once/if `Ad.featured` exists. | unchanged |
| `GET /api/my/ads` | Extended | Add `stage=ACTIVE\|SOLD\|DRAFT` filter for the CRM filter-sheet's "Status" field (§5) — today `/my/ads` always returns every stage with no way to narrow. | `Ad[]` unchanged |
| `GET /api/ads/top-districts` | New | Ranked district list for the home-feed rail. `prisma.ad.groupBy({by:['district','city'], where:{stage:'ACTIVE',active:true}, _count})`, ordered `count desc, district asc` (secondary key needed — seed data ties every district at count=1), `?limit=` default 4. | `[{district, city, count}]` |
| `GET /api/agents` | Extended | Add `?sort=adsCount&limit=` so Top Agents can be served without a new endpoint — `adsCount` is already computed here. | `[{id,fullName,email,phoneNumber,avatar,adsCount}]` unchanged shape |
| `GET /api/agents/:id` | Extended | Add `adsCount`, `dealsClosedCount` for the listing-detail agent block. | `{id,fullName,email,phoneNumber,avatar,adsCount,dealsClosedCount}` |
| `GET /api/saved-ads` | New | Current user's saved listings — backs both the heart-state merge on feed cards/listing-detail and the saved-listings grid screen (§17). | `[serializeAd]` (each with `saved:true`), newest-saved first |
| `POST /api/saved-ads/:adId` | New | Save (heart-on), idempotent upsert on `[userId, adId]`. | `{ ok: true }` |
| `DELETE /api/saved-ads/:adId` | New | Unsave (heart-off). | `204` |
| `GET /api/notifications` | New | List current user's notifications, newest first, for the notifications screen. | `[{id,type,title,body,adId,leadId,coworkerId,readAt,createdAt}]` |
| `GET /api/notifications/unread-count` | New | Powers the bell's unread indicator without fetching the full list. | `{ count: Number }` |
| `PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read` | New | Mark one notification read — the only interaction §22 actually specifies (every row is individually tappable). | `{ notification }` |
| `POST /leads` | Extended (side effect) | Also create a `LEAD_CREATED` Notification for the owning agent. Already logs `LEAD_CREATED` as an `ActivityEvent` (`leadService.js`) — extend the same call site. | unchanged response |
| `PATCH /ads/:id` | Extended (side effect) | When `stage` flips to `SOLD`, also create an `AD_SOLD` Notification. Already logs `AD_SOLD` as an `ActivityEvent` (`adService.js`) — same call site. | unchanged response |
| `POST /ads` | Extended (side effect) | When created with `coworkerId` set, also create a `COWORKER_AD_CREATED` Notification for the owning agent. `adService.js` already threads `actor.coworkerId` through this path. | unchanged response |
| `POST /publish/:channel/confirm` | Extended (side effect) | On a successful Instagram publish confirm, create an `IG_PUBLISHED` Notification for `requestedById`. Skip silently if `requestedById` is null (legacy/system-triggered confirm with no recorded requester). | unchanged response |

**Explicitly not adding:** `GET /api/utils/regions` (see §5 Decision 2/3), `GET /api/feed/home` (composed endpoint — see §1), `POST /api/notifications/read-all` (nothing in §22 asks for bulk mark-all-read), pagination/`view=summary` on `GET /my/ads` (different area — "My Ads" isn't part of this design's 3 screens).

## 5. Decisions you need to make

**1. Featured Listings: curated or algorithmic?**
The 3 shown ads (1001, 1003, 1004) skip 1002/1005/1007 in an order that's neither recency nor price — looks hand-picked, but there's no ADMIN role and no write path to set it today.
- *Option A*: `Ad.featured`/`featuredAt` (schema change above), someone flags ads by hand — needs a permission decision first.
- *Option B*: algorithmic proxy (newest 3 ACTIVE ads), zero schema change.
- **Recommendation: B for v1.** No ADMIN role exists to operate curation, and the mockup's actual pick doesn't match any obvious rule anyway — ship the cheap algorithmic version now, revisit curation once an ops/admin role is designed.

**2/3. District & region data: normalization and where `regions.json` lives.**
`Ad.district` is free text (`parseAdInput` does `String(body.district)`) — casing/typo variants can fragment `top-districts` groupBy counts. Separately, `apps/web/src/regions.json` (14 regions, 203 districts) only exists under `apps/web`; `apps/mobile` has no copy.
- **Recommendation:** move `regions.json` into a shared package (e.g. `packages/domain/src/data/regions.json`) that both `apps/web` and `apps/mobile` import at build time — no new API route, since it's static data that never changes at runtime. Defer city/district validation against that vocabulary at ad-write time; that's an ads-write-path change, out of scope for this pass.

**4. Explore Nearby: city-proxy or true geo-distance?**
No screen anywhere renders an actual distance value, despite the "nearby" framing.
- **Recommendation:** city-string equality proxy for v1 (`Ad.city` match against the location pill) — even after `Ad.lat/lng` exists (added for the map pin in §3), building real distance ranking + a location-permission flow isn't demonstrated by anything on screen. Revisit only if a future screen renders a distance figure.

**5. Saved/favorite exposure and role gating.**
- **Recommendation:** keep `GET /api/ads` and `GET /api/ads/:id` fully public and unmodified — don't bake a per-user `saved` flag into them (that requires a new "optional auth" middleware shape, and fragments cacheability of a public response). Use the separate `GET/POST/DELETE /api/saved-ads` above; client merges saved-state locally. Additionally, SCREENS.md (lines 136, 146) states the save/heart control is "shown only if role != agent" — enforce this server-side too: reject `POST`/`DELETE /api/saved-ads/:adId` for AGENT/COWORKER callers with 403, rather than leaving it a client-only UI convention.

**6. Top Agents: is this agent-only, or do coworkers appear as public peers?**
The mockup mixes 3 agents + 2 coworkers as flat entries, but `GET /api/coworkers` is Bearer-gated and scoped strictly to the coworker's own agent — there is no public read path for coworker identity anywhere today.
- **Recommendation:** agent-only for v1 (`GET /api/agents?sort=adsCount&limit=5`, already extended above). Making coworker identity public is a first-time access-control decision that shouldn't be made implicitly inside a feed-rail change — defer until someone explicitly decides coworkers should be publicly visible.

**7. Notifications: recipient roles, and how CALLBACK_REMINDER fires.**
All 5 seeded notification rows are agent/coworker-facing; none target plain USER accounts. Separately, CALLBACK_REMINDER is the one type with no existing write-trigger — it would need a new scheduled sweep + a dedupe column (`Lead.callbackReminderSentAt`).
- **Recommendation:** scope `Notification.recipientId` to AGENT/COWORKER only for v1 — no USER-facing notification type is designed anywhere yet. For callback reminders, compute "due now" live at request time (no cron, no dedupe column) — the onboarding permissions-primer copy (SCREENS.md line 96) only promises push for "new leads and publish status," not callback reminders, sold listings, or coworker activity. Build the real scheduled job only once push infrastructure for those types is separately decided.

*(Two smaller items resolved without needing a milestone: price-per-m² stays a client-side computed value from the existing `price`/`area` fields — no `pricePerSqm` column; the Nearby tab's distance suffix ("5 min") stays out of scope — `Ad.nearPlaces` remains a plain `String[]`, since the mockup's own suffixes are explicitly invented placeholder copy, not sourced data.)*

## 6. Suggested sequencing

**Milestone 1 — Favorites, agent detail, shared data.**
`SavedAd` table + `GET/POST/DELETE /api/saved-ads` (with role gate); `GET /agents/:id` adsCount/dealsClosedCount extension; move `regions.json` into a shared package. *Lights up:* consistent heart state everywhere, the listing-detail agent block, and unblocks mobile's district/city pickers.

**Milestone 2 — Listing detail completeness.**
`Ad.lat`/`Ad.lng`; `Ad.tour3dLink` + `AdPhoto.mediaType`; ship price-per-m² and nearby chips as client-side/no-schema per §5. *Lights up:* listing-detail is fully data-backed except an actual geocoding pipeline (agent manually pins, or a batch geocode job — separate follow-up).

**Milestone 3 — Search & discovery.**
`GET /api/ads` `q`/`sort`/`limit`+`cursor` and its index; `GET /my/ads` `?stage=`; `GET /api/ads/top-districts` and its index; `GET /api/agents` `?sort=&limit=`. If Decision 1 lands on Option A, add `Ad.featured`/`featuredAt` here too. *Lights up:* the listing-search screen (§4/§5) and the home-feed's Top Districts/Top Agents rails.

**Milestone 4 — Notifications.**
`Notification`/`NotificationType` (+ `packages/domain` mirror); the three read endpoints; wire notification-creation into `POST /leads`, `PATCH /ads/:id`, `POST /ads`, `POST /publish/:channel/confirm`; live-computed callback reminders. *Lights up:* the bell and the notifications screen (§22).

## 7. Risks and things we're choosing not to do

- **Not adding `AdSubtype`/`Ad.propertyType`.** The Apartment/House/Office/Retail chip row is wired identically to the (also non-functional) tab bar and detail-tab toggles — CSS class swaps, no fetch. The canonical filter screen (§5) doesn't list this axis at all. Leave the chips decorative, same status as the home-feed location pill, until the filter-sheet spec actually adds this dimension.
- **Not adding `AdPhoto.width/height/blurhash`.** The mockup's own CSS (`.hero{height:388px}`, `.gal__g img{height:108px;object-fit:cover}`) fixes every image slot's box regardless of intrinsic size — there's no loading-placeholder/skeleton UX specified anywhere in SCREENS.md or the mockup to justify this.
- **Not building a `PromoBanner` CMS table.** Both promo cards are hardcoded copy today and change rarely; keep them client-side until there's an actual ops need to rotate them without a release.
- **Not building `GET /api/feed/home`.** Every other multi-widget surface in this API composes client-side from separate endpoints (`GET /agents`, `GET /ads`, `GET /coworkers`, `GET /statistics/*`); a composed endpoint would force one cache TTL across rails of very different volatility (promo copy vs. live groupBy aggregates) for no requirement the design actually states.
- **Not adding cursor pagination or `view=summary` to `GET /my/ads`.** That's a different area (the CRM "My Ads" workspace, not part of this 3-screen design pass) — no screen here calls it.
- **Not building `POST /api/notifications/read-all`.** SCREENS.md §22 only describes per-row tap-to-read; a bulk clear-all is an invented feature.
- **Not building the CALLBACK_REMINDER cron sweep or its dedupe column yet** — see Decision 7.
- **Domain-package drift discipline:** `EventType` already has 6 Prisma-only members with no `packages/domain` mirror. Any new enum in this batch (`NotificationType`, `AdMediaType`, `Ad.featured` if built) must land its domain mirror (`packages/domain/src/enums/*.ts`) in the same PR as the Prisma migration, not after.
- **`packages/api-client`'s `Ad`/`AuthUser` interfaces carry a `[key: string]: unknown` escape hatch** — new fields (saved, lat/lng, tour3dLink) pass through with zero compiler signal unless the resource files are updated deliberately. Write real typed fields for the new `saved-ads` and `notifications` resources rather than relying on the escape hatch.
- **`docs/04-api-spec.md` is already stale** (documents routes that don't exist, misses real ones) — worth correcting in the same PR that ships any of these endpoints, not after, so drift doesn't compound.
- **No ADMIN role exists** (`UserRole`: USER/AGENT/COWORKER only) — relevant if Decision 1 ever moves to curated Featured Listings; not needed given the Option B recommendation.
